title: Lesson
description: Matches Kotlin Lesson(id, revision, title, objective, format, activities[], requiredActivityIds[], linkedPhraseIds[]=[], prerequisiteLessonIds[]=[]). A lesson does not derive a universal grammar template automatically; pattern_workshop activities must be explicitly authored. requiredActivityIds (not a per-activity flag, and never empty -- see its own description) is what the runner uses to decide which activities gate lesson completion.

requiredActivityIds.description: Activity ids (from activities[]) whose completion gates the lesson; required and non-empty (Kotlin ContentValidator's NO_REQUIRED_ACTIVITIES rule rejects an empty list -- there is no such thing as a lesson with zero required steps). A required activity may still honestly be unable to complete yet (e.g. a listening activity with no audio: it stays the required, blocking step, just permanently un-completable until real audio exists -- that is a runtime AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE outcome, not a reason to omit it here). Optional activities (e.g. Reflection, SpeakingPrompt) are simply left out of this array, never marked via a per-activity flag.

linkedPhraseIds.description: Recall phrase ids this lesson references; installing/completing a lesson never mutates recall scheduling directly.

prerequisiteLessonIds.description: Soft prerequisites: editorial ordering hints. The Kotlin validator DFS-checks these for cycles/unresolved references.
